**Finding: INDEMN — compliant (sits at the fallback).**

Section 8.1 delivers a genuine IBM IP defence-and-indemnity (patent, trademark, copyright, trade secret) covering Materials and Base Components IBM provides or uses in performing the Services, with only the customary exclusions the fallback permits (Customer-provided items, Customer modifications, combinations with non-IBM products, non-IBM hardware/software/data). All fallback remedies are present — procure continued use, modify, replace with functionally equivalent non-infringing items, and a credit of amounts paid (up to twelve months of charges) if none is reasonably available — plus standard notice/control/cooperation procedure with IBM reimbursing our above-nominal cooperation costs.

On the super-cap element, Section 9.1(a) carves indemnification payments under 8.1 out of the $100,000/twelve-months monetary cap in 9.1(c), so the indemnity is effectively uncapped — more favourable than the 3× annual fees the fallback would accept.

Noted but not redlined (preferred-only gaps): no IBM indemnity for breach of applicable law, IBM-caused data breach, or gross negligence/wilful misconduct; and our Section 8.2 indemnity is broader than Customer content plus breach of law, though the 8.2(c) carve-back for IBM's bad faith, wilful misconduct, gross negligence or breach mitigates it. No redline proposed.
